entities.name: Joseph Habib Hitti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Habib Hitti was a Lebanese-born Australian Maronite Catholic eparch (bishop) of the Maronite Catholic Eparchy of Saint Maron of Sydney from 23 November 1990 until 26 October 2001.
